title: Reinerius
summary: Raleigh names Reinerius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Reinerius, named with Antoninus and Valentia on the natural law. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IV, §. VI, sig. 189a
